name: Pressure switch or relay
summary: Provides an electrical response to a gas, liquid or other pressure condition.
description: Provides an electrical response to a gas, liquid or other pressure condition.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the monitored vessel or compartment and sensor contact. The associated drawing should trace the pressure alarm, trip or permissive path; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the monitored vessel or compartment and sensor contact.

drawingChecklist: Label the monitored vessel or compartment and sensor contact.
Cross-reference the pressure alarm, trip or permissive path.

distinction: Pressure supervision is not automatically a Buchholz gas-accumulation function; identify the sensor and the actual operating quantity.
